jobs.prompt: Create ONE photorealistic interior design concept by restyling the FIRST attached modeled living-room view. Preserve its exact camera, crop, perspective, room dimensions, ceiling height, wall contours, door openings, partitions, floor plane, furniture footprints, facing directions and clearances. Image2 is the SAME measured room from the opposite camera for geometry consistency. Image3 is Amy's design board and is ONLY material, finish and furniture-form reference; never use its front-elevation composition or enlarge this room. The output must match image1 composition: long four-seat charcoal sofa and exposed brick wall on LEFT; TV and low white console on RIGHT; back doorway near center-right remains open and unchanged, with its brick wall/white radiator visible beyond. Keep every visible object in its exact modeled position and scale. Upholster the existing sofa in realistic charcoal grey leather, retaining its full long straight profile and direction toward the TV. Enrich pink pillow fabric, optionally add a folded amethyst throw draped within the sofa silhouette. Keep the pink/tan/terracotta rug at its exact modeled outline, developing Amy's natural brown/pink graphic woven design with thin black borders. Refine existing white low oval coffee table within its precise modeled footprint, ivory sculptural form; keep white/gold round end tables exactly where modeled. Refine white media console into fine vertical fluting, subtle gold pulls, black short legs, retaining modeled width/height/depth and TV position. Restyle the existing gold-framed art IN ITS CURRENT FRAME into a rich painterly multicolor abstract with blush, ochre, teal/green and cream from Amy's board; keep art frame location and dimensions. Existing paired folded white fan sconces with gold stems stay on their modeled brick-wall locations. Realistic warm natural red/brown exposed brick and mortar texture at actual brick scale, neutral warm-white plaster, existing oak floor, gentle daylight and realistic material reflections/shadows. Gray bands on white model walls are shading, not new chair rails or wainscoting. Do not insert plants, extra furniture, new ceiling fixtures, doors, windows, shelves or architectural features. Do not mirror, reframe, widen, shorten, rotate or shift furniture. Preserve the measured apartment arrangement rather than the board layout. No people, labels, borders, watermarks or collage. Same landscape framing as the first reference.
